## Correction to: Genome Med 13, 123 (2021) https://doi.org/10.1186/s13073-021-00939-2

It was highlighted that in the original article [1] the UK Biobank Resource Application Number was incorrect (3934). The correct UK Biobank Resource Application Number is 33934. The authors also wished to add this sentence to their Acknowledgments section: “This research was conducted using the UK Biobank Resource under application 33934.” The original article has been updated.
